reviews.decision_reason: select_demand relies on demand_score and identifiers only. The supplied package does not show observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes supporting the retained demand claims, so the market-demand basis cannot be trusted from this evidence alone.

normalize truncates the selected records to a one-row index window, so only n06-r01 survives into the needs handoff. That drops other selected corpus records, including capability-matched demand records, and materially determines the downstream unsupported recommendation.

assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the normalized needs by demand_score descending and record_id, using missing-safe access for source fields. The observed one-row provenance output follows from the upstream normalized input rather than a localized fault in this unit.
